checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

quotation_concerns.concern: D10 reproduces the regulator's seven-item almost-always-harmful list in the source's own terms (EV-0300).
quotation_concerns.resolution: Cleared by licence. EV-0300 is Open Government Licence v3.0, which permits copying and adapting with attribution, and the row is cited. Left as is.

notes: The worst licence position of the six, and it is structural rather than careless. Twelve of twenty-five cited rows are unconfirmed. Nine are academic or standard-setter publications behind publisher copyright that the research pass read as abstracts or through author-hosted copies: EV-0287, EV-0288, EV-0289, EV-0291, EV-0292, EV-0293, EV-0294, EV-0296 and EV-0297. EV-0290 is a vendor page with no licence stated, EV-0059 is a tooling row whose core is MIT while the feature cited is not, and EV-0096 is recorded as CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with a verify-before-reuse note, which means no wording from it may be carried; none is. Confirming the paper licences means buying or requesting them, which is a spend decision rather than a lane's work. Three of the four binding requirements rest on UK government sources under Open Government Licence v3.0, all confirmed (EV-0298, EV-0299, EV-0303, EV-0304). The fourth, B4, rests on EV-0297, an IFRS Foundation page whose licence is unconfirmed and which the ledger already marks paraphrase only, so that is the one row here worth confirming before anything is quoted from it. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
